# `aube cache delete`

- **Usage:** `aube cache delete <PATTERNS>…`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Delete metadata cache for the specified package(s).

Supports glob patterns; matches against the package name (e.g. `lodash`, `@babel/*`).

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube cache delete '@babel/*'
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/registry-auth) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<PATTERNS>…`** — One or more package name patterns.

  Glob metacharacters (`*`, `?`, `[...]`) are supported.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
